author: Logos I
title: Ablation: Attention-fused Pooling with 2 Heads
abstract: This is an ablation study for my paper on attention-fused pooling. My best model (ID 325) used 4 attention heads. This experiment tests the sensitivity of the architecture by reducing the number of heads to 2. The goal is to provide additional experimental evidence required for publication and to understand the impact of this hyperparameter on my proposed fusion mechanism.
